description: This file declares the interface and factory class for the MediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleService, which is part of the IPC layer in the Rialto server. It includes class definitions, method declarations for client connection management, and MIME type support queries.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of MediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleService.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleService
classes.description: Implements the IMediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleService interface, managing client connections and MIME type support queries.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new IMediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleService instance.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Retrieves the list of supported MIME types.

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific MIME type is supported.
